def validate_task(env, final_answer=None) -> int:
    error_accumulator = []
    success_accumulator = []

    env.instance.load()
    seed = env.db("seed")
    current = env.db("current")

    TASK_FAILED_SCORE = 0
    TASK_SUCCESSFUL_SCORE = 1

    def find_new_entries(table_name, id_field="id", filter_conditions=None):
        """Compare seed vs current to find rows added by the agent."""
        before_query = seed.table(table_name)
        after_query = current.table(table_name)
        if filter_conditions:
            for key, value in filter_conditions.items():
                before_query = before_query.eq(key, value)
                after_query = after_query.eq(key, value)
        before_ids = set(entry[id_field] for entry in before_query.select(id_field).all())
        return [e for e in after_query.all() if e[id_field] not in before_ids]

    # Locate the Work Calendar dynamically rather than hardcoding its ID.
    work_calendar = current.table("calendars").eq("name", "Work Calendar").first()
    if not work_calendar:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Could not find a calendar named 'Work Calendar'")
        print(">>> ERROR_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
        print(error_accumulator)
        print("<<< ERROR_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        if success_accumulator:
            print(">>> SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
            print(success_accumulator)
            print("<<< SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        return TASK_FAILED_SCORE

    success_accumulator.append("[C] Found the Work Calendar")
    calendar_id = work_calendar["id"]

    new_events = find_new_entries(
        "calendar_events",
        id_field="id",
        filter_conditions={"calendarId": calendar_id}
    )

    matching_events = []
    for event in new_events:
        title_ok = event.get("title") == "Riverside lease review"
        start_ok = (event.get("startDateTime") or "").replace("Z", "").startswith("2025-08-18T14:00:00")
        end_ok = (event.get("endDateTime") or "").replace("Z", "").startswith("2025-08-18T15:00:00")
        location_ok = event.get("location") == "Conference Room B"
        reminder_ok = event.get("reminderMinutes") == 30
        show_as_ok = event.get("showAs") == "busy"
        description_text = (event.get("description") or "") + " " + (event.get("bodyHtml") or "")
        description_ok = "Review Riverside lease packet and next steps with housing team." in description_text

        if title_ok and start_ok and end_ok and location_ok and reminder_ok and show_as_ok and description_ok:
            matching_events.append(event)

    if matching_events:
        success_accumulator.append("[C] Created the requested Riverside lease review event with correct title, time, location, busy status, reminder, and description")
    else:
        if not new_events:
            error_accumulator.append("[X] No new event was created on the Work Calendar")
        else:
            error_accumulator.append("[X] A new Work Calendar event was created, but it did not match all requested details")

    if error_accumulator:
        print(">>> ERROR_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
        print(error_accumulator)
        print("<<< ERROR_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
    if success_accumulator:
        print(">>> SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
        print(success_accumulator)
        print("<<< SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR <<<")

    if error_accumulator:
        return TASK_FAILED_SCORE
    return TASK_SUCCESSFUL_SCORE
